intro.description: MeSH and ICD-10-CM are released every year. Hermes 2 includes them offline as packages of their own, so a new release is an update, not a new version of the application. SNOMED CT and LOINC are searched online with your own UMLS license.

item.title: Check for updates
item.description: Help > Check for Updates installs new releases of the application and of the terminologies from the update site of your installation.

item.title: Use SNOMED CT and LOINC
item.description: Enter the API key of your UMLS license on the Terminologies preference page and press Test. SNOMED CT and LOINC then appear in the keyword lookup.
item.onCompletion: The validation checks keyword codes against the offline releases you have; documents coded with an older release may get warnings after an update.
